theirReference: Cristian is really great person. Very kind and helpful. He showed us some places nearby and gave us some recommendations. Gracias por todo!
myReference: Mateusz and his girlfriend were an absolute pleasure to host! They were kind, respectful, and very clean — the kind of guests every host hopes for. They brought such good energy and positive vibes to my home, and even surprised me with a delicious homemade breakfast. We spent some time walking around La Candelaria together, and I had the chance to show them a bit of the city — they were curious, easygoing, and great company. I highly recommend them to any future host. You’ll be lucky to have them!
